packages.name: Starter
packages.tagline: Get your business in front of customers today.
packages.planDetail: Everything you need to start taking jobs through the platform. Pay a flat monthly fee and a small commission on what you earn — nothing more.

packages.name: Shield
packages.tagline: Stop overpaying on your biggest jobs.
packages.planDetail: Commission capped at 10% — so when you close a large job, you keep significantly more. One job can pay for this plan many times over.
packages.savingExample: On a R74,300 job: standard commission is R9,473. With your cap it's R7,430. You keep an extra R2,043 — from one job.

packages.name: Pro
packages.planDetail: A tighter commission cap plus a free Graphic Design service. One R10,000 job more than pays for the month.
packages.savingExample: On a R75,000 job: standard commission is R9,562. With your cap it's R7,125. You pocket R2,437 extra — more than 3× the monthly plan cost.

packages.name: Growth
packages.tagline: Built for providers closing jobs above R1,000 every week.
packages.planDetail: The cap kicks in at the second bracket — almost every job you close is cheaper. Plus a free Social Media Management service to fuel your inbound pipeline.
packages.savingExample: Every job above R1,000 is capped. On 5 × R10,000 jobs: save R7,500 compared to standard rates — in a single month.

packages.name: Elite
packages.tagline: The same rate on a R2,000 job as a R200,000 job.
packages.planDetail: Every sale above R999 is capped at 7.5% — the same rate as the smallest possible job. For high-ticket providers, this is the most powerful plan on the platform.
packages.savingExample: On a R200,000 project: standard commission is R25,500. With your 7.5% cap it's R15,000. You keep R10,500 more — from one project.
